# romergarcia.com

> The portfolio and creative-universe site of Romer Garcia, a multimedia designer and AI-driven design lead based in New York, NY. It hosts his design portfolio plus two connected original fiction projects: Paradoxxia and Reverb.

- Site owner: Romer Garcia — Design Lead & AI-Driven Multimedia Strategist, based in New York, NY. Available for multimedia design, AI-assisted design, creative direction and brand transformation work.
- The site is a single-page React application. Every route listed below is also served as pre-rendered HTML containing the page's text, metadata and schema.org JSON-LD, so no JavaScript execution is required to read it.
- Canonical host: https://romergarcia.com

## Portfolio

- [Home / portfolio](https://romergarcia.com/): Romer Garcia's design portfolio — selected projects, background, image gallery and contact form.
- [Contact](https://romergarcia.com/contact): contact form.

## Reverb / the Paradoxxiaverse

Reverb is an original character-driven narrative franchise set in the Paradoxxia universe (the "Paradoxxiaverse"), created and written by Romer Garcia. It is a prequel chapter following outsiders who turn sound into resistance. The premise: the crew never shared a headquarters, only a frequency — different cities, different decades, "different steps, same frequency."

The franchise has six character sheets: five public members of the Reverb Collective plus one hidden variant. Story content is released as serialized "transmissions" — dated archive entries containing artwork, recovered documents, lore, locations, audio and anomalies. Parts of the archive and some character sheets are locked and unlock over time.

- [Reverb overview](https://romergarcia.com/reverb): franchise premise, the Collective roster, and an FAQ.
- [Reverb downloads](https://romergarcia.com/reverb/downloads): free wallpapers and printable posters for Collective members.
- [Reverb (character)](https://romergarcia.com/reverb/reverb): Urban Operative and founder of the Collective.
- [Spark](https://romergarcia.com/reverb/spark): demolitions, close-quarters, runner.
- [Harmonix](https://romergarcia.com/reverb/harmonix): strategy and tactical technology.
- [Eduq](https://romergarcia.com/reverb/eduq): hacking and experimental technology.
- [Wida](https://romergarcia.com/reverb/wida): temporal traveler and connector.
- A sixth character sheet, a post-incident variant of Spark, is hidden and unlocks later.

## Paradoxxia

Paradoxxia is an AI-synthesized multimedia artist and character entity created by Romer Garcia: a dystopian sci-fi setting ("the Cyber Boondocks") paired with AI-generated cinematic electronic music, released on Spotify and Apple Music.

- [Paradoxxia](https://romergarcia.com/paradoxxia): the artist and universe hub.
- [AI Character Generator](https://romergarcia.com/char-gen): free web tool that generates a character in the Paradoxxia universe with a portrait, backstory and stats.
- [Story mode](https://romergarcia.com/story): interactive AI-driven roleplay of an encounter with Paradoxxia.
